title: Meet the True One before you brace
summary: The heart is saved as ego is subdued and hostile energies are made to serve. Put faith in the True Guru before self-protection becomes another scheme.
takeaway: Let the True Guru subdue the ego before fear drafts a plan.
lifeApplication: When you feel yourself bracing, pause long enough to ask whether this plan comes from faith or from ego trying to survive.

source.shortMeaning: Rescue arrives as ego is subdued and the forces that once attacked are brought under the True Guru’s trust.
source.lifeApplication: When outcomes tighten you, turn to the True One before you strategize.

evidence.coreClaim: Fear begins to leave when ego is subdued and the heart places its trust in the True Guru instead of its own schemes.
evidence.turn: Let ego and scheming fall so fear can leave with them.
evidence.practicalImplication: When you feel yourself bracing, pause long enough to ask whether this plan comes from faith or from ego trying to survive.
